desc: Landmark Cars Limited has submitted to the exchange that the Notice of 20th Annual General Meeting scheduled to be held on Thursday, September 24, 2026 at 3:00 PM. AGM Notice along with Integrated Annual Report of the Company for the Financial Year 2025-26 is attached herewith.
Landmark Cars Limited has submitted to the exchange Integrated Annual Report of the Company for the Financial Year 2025-26.
Landmark Cars Limited has submitted to the exchange Business Responsibility and Sustainability Report for FY 2025-26.
